request.style: English, male baritone solo with soft choir, acoustic guitar, fiddle, bodhran, harp, cello, solemn and reflective mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A name in the list of the sons
Sered from the line of Zebulun
First of three, a bloodline drawn
In the census of the old world known

[Chorus]
From Sered, the Seredite clan
The name is written in the sand
A son of Zebulun, faithful and true
In the record of Jacob's crew

[Verse]
Seventy souls went down to Egypt
During the famine, time and light
Joseph held power in that land
While the family crossed the strand

[Chorus]
From Sered, the Seredite clan
The name is written in the sand
A son of Zebulun, faithful and true
In the record of Jacob's crew

[Verse]
On the plains of Moab, the count
The clans are listed, no doubt
Sered, Elon, and Jahleel
The lineage of the tribe is real

[Bridge]
From the firstborn to the final name
The history of Israel's fame
In the books of Chronicles, we see
The roots of the tribes set free

[Outro]
Sered, the first of the three
A name in the genealogy
From Zebulun, a line so true
The Seredite clan, standing new
